Name: Skip Long Animations
Author: ninjor1
Description:
[size=5][b]Skip Long Animations[/b][/size]

Cuts animations that take longer than they need to, so you can get on with your day.

[size=4][b]What it skips[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Pam's bus:[/b] when you take the bus to or from the Calico Desert, you get on as soon as you buy the ticket instead of walking to the door. Once the door shuts, the screen fades and the bus is already parked at the other end, opening its door for you. The ticket price, Pam needing to be at work, and the reminder that your horse is waiting at the bus stop all work as in the base game.[/*]
[*][b]Clint's geodes:[/b] Clint cracks geodes, artifact troves, Golden Coconuts and mystery boxes 5x faster. You still see the hammer, the crack and what was inside.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
Change them in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], even in the middle of a game, or in the mod's [font=Courier New]config.json[/font].
[list]
[*][b]Skip the bus ride[/b] (on by default): turn it off to get the base game's bus ride back.[/*]
[*][b]Geode cracking speed[/b] (5x by default): from 1x (the base game's speed) up to 10x.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url], then unzip this mod into your game's [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.

In multiplayer, each player can install it or not; it only changes what you see.

[size=4][b]Source and bug reports[/b][/size]
The source code is on GitHub: [url=https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods]https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods[/url]
Please report bugs and suggestions as [url=https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods/issues]GitHub issues[/url].

Manifest.Name: Skip Long Animations
Manifest.Description: Skips Pam's bus ride to and from the desert, and makes Clint crack geodes faster.
